description: This PHP file defines a class 'Task' within the Opencart Admin Controller for handling scheduled cron tasks, specifically to start a process if no tasks are currently processing.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing cron tasks, primarily to trigger start scripts when no processing tasks are active.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for executing the cron task; checks the number of processing tasks and initiates the start process if none are processing.
